messages:
Maya: Quick sync  we need a one-page sales brief + 3 hero slides + webinar blurb focused on security, SLAs, and deployment choices. Keep it field-friendly.
Diego: I'll take the one-pager. Structure: problem, our approach, deployment matrix, benchmark vignette, routing snippet, CTA. Under 500 words.
Harper: For the benchmark vignette use neutral phrasing: 'Customer migrated to reserved pools + KV caching and saw stable latency under peak load.' No hard numbers until infra signs off.
Leo: Deployment matrix idea: rows = Hosted / Dedicated / Private; cols = Speed to deploy, Predictability, Data controls, Ops burden. Short cells only.
Nina: Webinar plan: 20 min presentation (customer story + demo of routing/fallback) + 10 min Q/A. Promo line: 'How to serve LLMs with enterprise security and predictable SLAs.'
Maya: A/B headlines for the landing page: A) 'Secure, SLA-backed LLM inference' B) 'Predictable LLM performance for regulated apps'  we'll test both.
Diego: Draft CTAs: 'Request capacity review' and 'Book security walkthrough.' Add objection handling: 'No tuning on customer corp data by default; optional private control plane; KMS & audit logs.'
Harper: Routing rules (example YAML for ops):
```
- keywords: ["security","compliance","fedramp"]
  route_to: "ae_security"
- keywords: ["sla","p95","throughput","latency"]
  route_to: "enterprise_sales"
- keywords: ["vpc","on-prem","air-gapped"]
  route_to: "platform_sales"
- fallback: "growth"
```
Leo: I'll push a 3x4 grid mock and the slides by Wed morning. Add a Figma placeholder link in the doc.
Nina: Promo blurb for email/web: 'Join us for a 30-minute session: engineering leads show how to balance security, SLAs, and deployment choices for production LLMs. Live demo + Q/A.'
Maya: Timeline: Diego draft by Tue 17:00 UTC, Leo slides Wed 09:00 UTC, Harper will review benchmark language before publish. ops-bot: Reminder set  draft Tue 17:00 UTC, slides Wed 09:00 UTC.
Diego: I'll keep the one-pager concise and share speaker notes for slides.
